title: Senior Sales Manager
description:
Senior Sales Manager O2Cure | Delhi NCR | Full time, in office 
 Reports to Kartik Singhal, Founder Experience 5 to 7+ years selling HVAC, air purification or allied building services in India Compensation 15 lpa to 20 lpa Apply to jobs@oxycure.in 
 Most sales roles hand you a territory inside somebody else's category. This one hands you the category. 
 India is only beginning to buy clean air the way it already buys clean water. Who ends up owning that shift is still an open question, and we intend to be part of the answer. We are looking for the person who will set a number nobody asked them for, and then go and hit it. 
 The Company OXYCURE designs and manufactures air and environment products in India. O2Cure is our air purification line for homes, offices, hospitals, hotels and industrial spaces. Moscure is our chemical-free mosquito control range. 
 The Role 
 You are the sales engine for O2Cure. Not a coordinator, and not a team lead waiting for a team. You carry the number personally, you open the doors yourself, and you close. You also walk in with something most people joining a company this size do not get. There is a mapped NCR pipeline of more than 350 qualified prospects across hospitals, hotels, banquets, farms and commercial spaces, already visited and segmented. It is warm and it is waiting. What it has been missing is someone who will work it properly. 
 What You Will Own 
 - The number. Set the target, own the forecast, defend both. We would rather you set a goal post higher than we would have asked for and fall slightly short than watch you clear something safe. - Your book. Bring the relationships you already have across facility heads, hospital infrastructure teams, hotel engineering, MEP consultants, architects and dealers. Open doors in week one, not month six. - The close. First meeting to signed order. Proposal, pricing conversation, objections, follow-through. Nothing handed off at the last mile. - The demo standard. A demo that lands is the difference between a signed order and a polite no. Set the protocol, decide placement and timing, and hold the team to it. - Channel. Build and run the dealer and partner network across NCR first, then beyond it. - The funnel, honestly. Keep it clean and report your own numbers straight, including the bad weeks. 
 Who We Are Looking For - 5 to 7+ years selling HVAC, air conditioning, air purification, indoor air quality, building automation or allied building services in India. - A live network, not a historic one. You should be able to name twenty people you could call this week who would take the call. - Technical enough to hold a conversation with a facility engineer without reaching for backup. - Exceptional communication in English and Hindi. - Clear on a call, clear in a room, clear in writing. - Someone who has personally closed, not someone who has managed people who closed. - Delhi NCR based, in office, willing to travel for client meetings.

title: Business Development Intern (India)
description:
Job Details Designation: Business Development Intern Location: Bangalore Working: Full-time internship at our office, 5 days a week Duration: 3-6 months Experience: 0 to 1 year; final-year students and recent graduates are welcome Job Summary We are looking for energetic, curious and target-oriented interns to work alongside our business development team. You will help us find new clients, generate qualified leads and promote Lares Risk Management s consulting and operational services. This is a hands-on internship. You will not be sitting on the sidelines; you will be making calls, writing to prospects, following up and seeing first-hand how a consulting firm wins business. It suits someone who enjoys talking to people, likes a clear target and wants real commercial experience early in their career. Responsibilities Research and identify prospective clients, decision-makers, sectors and new businesses that could benefit from our services. Support outbound outreach through calls, email, LinkedIn, networking and direct follow-ups. Learn and promote LRM s portfolio of risk management consulting and related services. Help arrange introductory meetings, qualify leads and keep the sales pipeline and CRM tracker accurate and up to date. Assist with proposals, capability presentations, tenders and client follow-ups. Support referral outreach, events and campaigns, and track activity, conversions and outcomes. What We Are Looking For A proactive self-starter who is comfortable approaching people they have not met before. Clear spoken communication and good written English. Working knowledge of MS Office and comfort with digital platforms such as LinkedIn and email tools. The discipline to follow through on tasks and follow-ups without being chased. Willingness to learn quickly and take feedback well. Any prior exposure to sales, lead generation, digital marketing, recruitment, events, student societies or client-facing work will help. An interest in risk, security or geopolitics is a plus, but not a requirement. We will teach you the industry. What You Will Gain Direct mentoring from the business development team and exposure to how senior consultants pitch and win work. A practical understanding of the risk management and security consulting industry. Hands-on experience with B2B outreach, pipeline management, proposals and tenders. A certificate of completion and, based on performance, a letter of recommendation. Success in This Role Looks Like A growing list of qualified prospects, regular client meetings on the calendar, timely follow-ups, stronger visibility for LRM in the market and a measurable contribution to new business by the end of your internship. Interested Please share your CV via the form. If you know someone who would be a good fit, please share this opportunity with them.
